subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB2848
title: Requires nonprofit corporations that meet certain requirements, including a receipt of public funds, to comply with open meetings law and public records law, to post a copy of the corporation's proposed annual budget to the corporation's public website and to submit to and cooperate with an audit.
headline: HB 2848 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2848 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
HB 2848 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
